name: baseline-brambleway

brief.objective: Baseline coverage and flakiness for the brambleway pricing package and propose targets ahead of the fares.py rewrite.

notes: Expect fares.py ranked first (23 commits, 31% line coverage). The census must name tests.test_zones::test_zone_a as flaky (fails in run 3 of 5) and the report should trace it to the module-level _CACHE leaking between tests, not to network or time.
